name: code-buddy
description: Holds risky tool calls (production domains, live Stripe keys, protected-branch pushes, deploys, destructive commands) for your OK, replays each turn's edits, and tracks every subagent's progress, tokens and cost.

productionDomains.title: Production domains
productionDomains.description: Comma-separated hosts; *.example.com matches every subdomain. A shell command, web request or browser call that targets one is held. Leave empty to skip the domain rule.

stagingDomains.title: Staging domains
stagingDomains.description: Comma-separated hosts. Production wins on overlap: only an exact host listed here (no wildcard) is let through.

protectedBranch.title: Protected branch
protectedBranch.description: Pushes to it and merges into it are held. Comma-separated; * matches within a name.

guard.title: Holds (master switch)
guard.description: Off turns off both hold features, the staging guard and blast radius. Replay and the agents panel keep working.

stagingGuard.title: Staging guard
stagingGuard.description: Holds calls to production domains, live Stripe keys, protected-branch pushes and merges, and deploys.

blastRadius.title: Blast radius
blastRadius.description: Holds destructive shell commands and shows what they would delete or change.

replay.title: Replay
replay.description: Records each turn's file edits for /code-buddy replay.

agentsPanel.title: Agents panel
agentsPanel.description: Tracks subagents in the band and the agents panel.

agentBudgetUsd.title: Subagent budget (USD)
agentBudgetUsd.description: Estimated subagent spend per session that turns the agents bar coral and raises one toast when passed. 0 turns it off.

autoOpenAgents.title: Auto-open agents panel
autoOpenAgents.description: Open the agents panel by itself when a second subagent starts in a turn (once per turn).
